entities.name: Pho Lai Pagoda
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Chùa Phổ Lại (Pho Lai Pagoda) is a monastic institution of the Vietnam Buddhist Sangha in Phong Thái Ward, Huế City, Vietnam. The pagoda is active in religious and community activities. It also has cultural and charitable programs in the midland region of Huế.
